goal: Shorten text to a number of words.

tasks.title: Add truncateWords
tasks.description: Keep the first n words (split on whitespace, joined with one space); when words were dropped, append "...".
scenarios: Given "the quick brown fox" When truncateWords is called with n 2 Then it returns "the quick..."
Given "the quick" When truncateWords is called with n 5 Then it returns "the quick"
Given " a  b " When truncateWords is called with n 2 Then it returns "a b"
Given any text When truncateWords is called with n 0 Then it returns "..." unless the text has no words, then ""
changelog: truncateWords shortens text to n words
